user.title: Authorize CozyLife
user.description: Enter the current Identity Authorization code shown in the CozyLife app under Account Settings → Personal Information. Your account token and authorization code are not stored.

device.title: Choose a CozyLife device
device.description: Choose a Smart Switch or Metering Socket. Name, model, and cloud endpoint come from your account; the LAN IP is discovered automatically. If LAN discovery is unavailable, cloud control remains available.

reconfigure.title: Refresh CozyLife authorization
reconfigure.description: Enter a current authorization code to refresh the device key and relay endpoint, or upgrade an existing local-only entry. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read CozyLife account metadata. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Authorization was rejected. Obtain a current Identity Authorization code from the app.
error.device_not_found: Choose a device from the list.

abort.already_configured: Device is already configured. Reconfigure the existing entry to enable or refresh cloud fallback.
abort.no_devices: No supported Smart Switch or Metering Socket with cloud credentials was found.
abort.device_not_found: This device was not found in the authorized account.
abort.authorization_required: Use an Authorization code to add a device.
abort.reconfigure_successful: CozyLife device credentials and endpoints have been updated.
